description: Traffic light consent/safeword system for real-time scene communication. Universal, non-verbal compatible, and integrated with all scene types.

design_principles.principle_1: Traffic lights are checked before, during, and after every scene.
design_principles.principle_2: Yellow is not failure. Yellow is communication.
design_principles.principle_3: Red stops everything. No negotiation during red.
design_principles.principle_5: The Dominant also has traffic light rights.

yellow.meaning: Slow down, decrease intensity, or change the current action.

red.meaning: Stop everything immediately. Drop character. Transition to care.

non_verbal_alternatives.description: When speech is restricted, these alternatives are pre-negotiated.

double_tap.name: Double Tap
double_tap.description: Two rapid taps on partner's body or floor

signals.one_squeeze: Green — I am present and safe
signals.two_squeezes: Yellow — I am hitting a limit, back off

drop_signal.name: Drop Signal
drop_signal.description: Holding a heavy object (keys/coin). If dropped, scene stops instantly.

thumb_system.name: Thumb System
thumb_system.description: For neurodivergent partners or when verbal communication is impossible

steps: Confirm traffic light system is agreed
Confirm both parties know their rights

during_scene.dominant_responsibility: Check in at phase transitions and after intensity peaks

steps: Transition to aftercare if yellow or red was used

integration_with_systems.reward_system: Yellow or red signals may trigger reward or recovery actions
integration_with_systems.punishment_system: Traffic lights are never overridden by punishment. Red stops everything.
integration_with_systems.recovery_system: Red signals trigger immediate recovery protocol
integration_with_systems.dbt_techniques: STOP and TIPP techniques are used after red signals
